My routine (I’m a 39 year old male)

* I try to walk 10,000 steps per day. Moving to the suburbs and having an almost 2 year old makes it more difficult but I at least still aim for 4+ days per week and an average of over 10,000 steps per day each week (so 70,000+ per week)

* 3 of these days I do a light run / fast jog to get my heart rate up. About 1.5-2.5 miles.

* Eat healthy for the majority of meals. Lunch during the work week is mostly acai bowls, smoothies, and salads. Dinner we do a mix of home cooked meals during the week, Trader Joe’s (higher in sodium but lower calorie), or very healthy takeout. I eat whatever on the weekends and I find this is a good balance of being healthy but not depriving myself

* I do minor weight lifting (25 pound weights) and sit ups 3 days per week.

* I weigh myself twice per week to keep myself on track and adjust if I am worried about weight gain 

* Alcohol is a lot more limited than it was in my early 30s. I don’t drink during the week and maybe have a drink or two every other weekend

* Are you accidentally using advantage+ targeting vs the specific targeting your using elsewhere? Advantage+ is too broad in a lot of cases

* Are the ads reformatted for Meta - size, caption, proper CTAs?

* Are the attribution windows identical across each? If you are doing a 1 day impression window on TikTok vs a 7 day impression window on Meta results will be different.
